_readme: PLACEHOLDER copy for the customer Frame Types screen. Edit name, bestFor, desc, pros, cons, and installNote. placeholder:true shows the placeholder badge (Settings can hide badges). installType must be an id in data/install.json. Choosing this frame on an estimate line sets that install type and its per-window price. diagram is the picture key: zbar, block, or nailfin.

types.name: Z-bar / Retrofit
types.bestFor: Replacement into the existing frame. A common choice on stucco homes when the old frame stays.
types.desc: The new window sits inside the frame that is already in the wall. A Z-shaped fin hooks over that old frame so the joint is covered from the outside.
pros: Stucco and drywall usually stay put
No full tear-out of the old frame
cons: The glass opening gets a little smaller
The old frame has to be solid and close to square
types.installNote: The old sash comes out. The new window clips into the existing frame and the Z-bar covers the outside edge. Caulk seals the fin.

types.name: Block Frame
types.bestFor: An opening that is already clear — the old frame is gone, or the pocket was built for a plain box frame.
types.desc: A simple box with no fin. It slides into the rough opening and is screwed through the frame into the wall.
pros: No fin to hide or trim around
Easy to shim until it is square
A clean look in a prepared opening
cons: The opening has to be ready — the frame will not cover a missing wall
Outside trim or stucco is a separate step
types.installNote: Set the box in the opening, shim it square, and screw through the jamb. Close the outside edge with trim or a stucco return.

types.name: Nailing Fin
types.bestFor: New construction, or a full tear-out where the wall face is open. Used on stucco homes that are re-finished outside.
types.desc: A flat fin around the window is nailed to the wall sheathing. Stucco or siding then covers the fin.
pros: The fin is a built-in flange for flashing
The usual frame when the wall is open
cons: The outside skin has to be open, or the old window fully removed
It does not mount over a frame you are keeping
types.installNote: Nail the fin to the sheathing, flash it, then let stucco or siding lap over the fin. On a replacement, the old frame comes out first.
